description: ALFOSC (Andalucia Faint Object Spectrograph and Camera) is the primary optical instrument on the 2.56-meter Nordic Optical Telescope (NOT), providing imaging in Bessell, interference, and SDSS filters.
facility_description: The Nordic Optical Telescope (NOT) is a 2.56-meter optical/infrared telescope located at Roque de los Muchachos Observatory on La Palma, Canary Islands.
notes: Filter-only transmissions from the NOT filter database (filter numbers as listed there for the ALFOSC set-ups). Telescope, detector and atmosphere are not included.

B.Comments: Edge marking on the list is B-BAND 16888. Other B filters are also catalogued.

R.Comments: Edge marking on the list is R-BAND 19237. NOT #10 is a separate Bessell R entry.

U.Comments: The list comment is Bessell U with a red-leak block. A second Bessell U (NOT #6) is also listed.

V.Comments: Edge marking on the list is V-BAND 16889.

i_int.Comments: The list comment for these entries is interference i, not a Bessell or SDSS i filter.

gp.Comments: The 60 mm g' copy, NOT #83, is also an SDSS-set filter but the list says it does not fit in ALFOSC.

ip.Comments: The 60 mm i' copy, NOT #85, is an SDSS-set filter but the list says it does not fit in ALFOSC.

rp.Comments: The 60 mm r' copy, NOT #84, is an SDSS-set filter but the list says it does not fit in ALFOSC.

up.Comments: NOT #82 is marked as part of the SDSS set.
